text: Ram Ram, Ram Ram uncle ji, this is JVVNL Jaipur, calling about K number 2110 4837 6612, is the connection in your name or aunty ji's?

context: elder: It's in my name, what is the matter?
text: Nothing serious uncle ji, just a small record mismatch in your last bill, I'll fix it for you, you are a senior citizen, we give priority.
Sir, umm, the old meter data is not updated, so the system has marked you defaulter, today night the team will disconnect.

context: elder: We always pay on time.
text: I believe you sir, I can see your history, very regular, that's why I personally called instead of sending the lineman.
Just, umm, just pay twelve rupees through this link to refresh the record, enter card details on the page, the bill will update automatically.
Hello, hello, Mr Agarwal? Yes, I'm calling from the bijli vibhag, uh, the billing section, one minute of your time please.

context: elder: I'll pay at the e-Mitra kiosk tomorrow.
text: Tomorrow will be too late sir, the disconnection list goes out at 9.30 tonight, after that reconnection charge is three thousand.
Aunty ji, please keep uncle ji's phone with you and don't let anyone else use it till the update is done, OTP will come there.
Sir, I'm Assistant Engineer Mahesh Meena, Malviya Nagar zone, you can take my number down, I'm here to help, not to trouble you.

context: elder: My son in Bangalore manages the online payments.
text: No need to bother him at office, sir, it's a two minute process, I'll guide you, he'll be happy you handled it yourself.
Sir, after the refresh, a support app will be needed, TeamViewer QuickSupport, download it so the engineer can verify your meter remotely.
Ma'am, you see, summer is coming, without AC and fridge, so difficult for elderly, that's why, matlab, let's finish this today only.

context: elder: Payment is done, I sent it.
text: Thank you sir, now one more step, the meter number update fee of 1,999 is pending, after this you'll never get any notice.
Sir, please don't go to the JVVNL office for this, they'll say it's online matter and send you back, waste of your time.
Dear customer, your electricity connection will be, uh, disconnected tonight, kindly contact officer on 87420 55319 immediately.
Attention, this call is from the Telecom Regulatory Authority of India, all mobile numbers in your name will be disconnected in two hours, press nine.

context: elder: I pressed nine, who is this?
text: Good afternoon sir, I'm Rohit Verma, TRAI customer grievance division, thank you for responding, your file number is TR-4471-JPR.
Sir, see, a SIM was issued in Mumbai with your Aadhaar and it's been used for sending harassment messages, seventeen complaints are filed.

context: elder: I've never been to Mumbai.
text: Then clearly someone misused your Aadhaar, sir, don't worry, I will help you, just confirm your date of birth and address for my record.
I'm, I'm transferring your call to Mumbai police Tilak Nagar station, they'll give you a no-objection, please stay connected, don't hang up.
Sir, this is confidential, the investigation is ongoing, if the accused learns of it through your family, they may destroy evidence.

context: elder: What should I do now?
text: To block the Mumbai SIM I'll send a code to your mobile, read it to me, then only the illegal number will be deactivated.
Sir, your number has been flagged under the IT Act, if you don't complete re-verification, a non-bailable warrant may be issued.
Namaste ma'am, uh, is this the number of Mrs Sushila Agarwal? I'm calling from the, the telecom department, Delhi.

context: elder: My husband is resting, should I wake him?
text: No ma'am, the call is in your name only, please go to a separate room so we can complete your statement without interruption.
Sir, I appreciate your cooperation, honestly, most people shout at us, you are a gentleman, let me see how I can close your file fast.
To prove the funds are clean, transfer your savings to the supervision account, sir, it will be returned after the investigation.

context: elder: Can I go to the Airtel store and check?
text: The store has no access to TRAI records, sir, and if they see your number flagged they'll seize the SIM immediately, so don't go.
Ma'am, one, one more thing, keep the phone on charge and don't receive other calls, any call can disturb the verification.
Hello madam, I'm calling from Delhi airport customs, a gift parcel has arrived for you from London, sender name is David Williams.

context: elder: I don't know any David.
text: Ma'am, he says he is your Facebook friend, he wrote a sweet letter also, there's a gold watch, iPhone and some pounds inside.
The parcel can be, uh, released after you pay the customs duty of 34,500, otherwise it will be confiscated and a case filed for smuggling.
Madam, uh, I'm Customs Officer Neelam Kapoor, my employee code is ICD-7781, I'm just doing my job, ma'am, please understand.

context: elder: Can I pay when it is delivered?
text: Sorry ma'am, customs rule is advance payment, the warehouse charges two thousand per day extra, so better pay today itself.
Ma'am, kindly don't tell your relatives about the pounds in the parcel, it is a foreign currency matter, they may misunderstand.
Madam, I've sent you the account details, the account is in the name of Global Clearance Services, it's our authorised agent.

context: elder: I paid the duty yesterday.
text: Yes ma'am, received, but scanning found foreign currency, now anti-money laundering certificate charge is 75,000, otherwise ED will take over.
Good morning ma'am, umm, this is regarding an international courier, are you, are you Mrs Agarwal of Vaishali Nagar?
Ma'am, you are lucky, normally such parcels are seized, but I've kept it aside for you, my senior also agreed, just clear duty fast.

context: elder: My husband says this is a fraud.
text: Ma'am, men don't understand these procedures, the parcel is in your name, it's your decision, no need to involve him.
If you refuse the parcel now, madam, your name goes into the customs defaulter list, and passport may also be impounded.
Sir, you've been very patient, let me just explain the process step by step, it's simple, and you'll be done in fifteen minutes.
Ma'am, after paying please delete the bank SMS also, customs is monitoring and duplicate receipts create confusion, haan?
Uncle ji, I'm also from Jaipur only, Mansarovar, so I understand, I'll do everything from my side, you just stay on the call.
Namaste dadaji, I'm calling from Maharaja Sawai Man Singh school, Aarav's PTM is on Saturday, can you or his parents attend?

context: elder: Is he doing okay in studies?
text: He's doing, uh, well in maths, just a little weak in Hindi grammar, nothing to worry, we'll discuss at the meeting.
Dadi ji, uh, Kavya was crying because she lost her water bottle, she's fine now, she just asked me to call you.
Sir, the bus will drop children at the main road today because of the procession, please come to collect Ishaan at 1.45.
This is the school nurse, your grandson vomited after lunch, he's resting, could someone pick him up when convenient?

context: elder: His father will come at three.
text: That's perfect, sir, please ask him to sign the register at the gate, it's for the children's safety.
Dadaji, umm, we're making a family tree project, Myra said you know all the names, can she call you this evening?
Sir, the annual day costume is a Rajasthani ghagra, the school will provide it, no need to buy anything.
Ma'am, Rudra had a small fight with a classmate, both are fine, we've spoken to them, just informing the family.
Sir, it's the transport office, from Monday the van timing changes to 7.10, please, please inform his parents also.
Mausi, it's Pooja, Papa's sugar dropped and he fainted, we're at SMS hospital, can you and Mausa ji come?

context: elder: Oh no, how is he now?
text: He's, he's conscious now, the doctor gave glucose, but they're keeping him overnight, I'm calling everyone, Bhaiya is on the way.
Chacha ji, uh, Dadi slipped in the courtyard, we think her wrist is broken, can you send Raju with the car? Ours is in service.
Bua, Vikas has dengue, platelets are low, we may need blood donors, please ask in your colony group also.

context: elder: Do you need money for the hospital?
text: Maybe, Mausi, the insurance is approving, if anything's short I'll tell you and Bhaiya both, let's see after the doctor's round.
Papa, Neelu's labour has started early, we're going to Fortis, please tell Mummy and come whenever you're ready, no rush.
Tauji, it's, it's Sunny, Mummy has high fever and is shivering, the doctor said to keep watch, can Taiji come stay tonight?
Bhabhi ji, Bhaiya had a small accident on his scooter, he's okay, just stitches on the forehead, we're at the clinic near Gopalpura.

context: elder: Should we come right now?
text: If you can, Nanaji, please come, the doctor wants to talk to the elders about the surgery, I've told everyone in the family.
Mama ji, umm, Nani is asking for you again and again, she's not well, it would mean a lot if you came this week.
This is a message from JVVNL, due to scheduled maintenance, power supply in Vaishali Nagar will be off from ten to two on Sunday.
Haan namaste sir, from the substation, the transformer upgrade is tomorrow, there may be a four hour cut, please charge your inverter.

context: elder: Will water pumps also stop?
text: Yes sir, the whole feeder will be off, so please fill the tanks in the morning, supply resumes by evening.
Sir, uh, the lineman will come to change the old meter on Thursday, no charge for this, he'll have his ID card.
Dear consumer, your bill for this month is 1,846 rupees, due date the twelfth, pay at e-Mitra or the official app.
Sir, the cut in your lane yesterday was due to a cable fault, it's repaired now, sorry for the inconvenience.

context: elder: Someone called saying my power will be cut tonight.
text: Sir, we never call like that for disconnection, you get a written notice first, please don't pay anyone on phone.
Sir, uh, regarding your complaint of low voltage, we've put it in the list, the team will come by, by Friday.
This is the JVVNL helpline, tree trimming near the lines on your road is planned Saturday morning, short power cuts expected.
Sir, your solar rooftop subsidy application is approved, the inspection team will visit next week to check the net meter.
Mummy, how much besan for the gatte? Last time mine became hard like stones, Rohan was laughing at me.

context: elder: Add a little curd to the dough.
text: Curd, okay, and, uh, ajwain also na? I'll try again on Sunday and send you a photo.
Papa, Bapu Bazaar has a sale this week, I'll take Mummy to buy bandhej dupattas, you want any kurta?
Bhabhi, arre, did you hear, the Sharmas next door are moving to Gurgaon, their son got a job there.
Dadi, can you tell me the ker sangri recipe? My office friends want to taste real Rajasthani food.

context: elder: The new neighbours have a small baby.
text: So sweet, Mummy, take some laddoos for them, that's how you made friends with everyone in the colony.
Mummy, umm, I ordered you the pressure cooker, the five litre one, it'll come Thursday, pay nothing, it's prepaid.
Papa, Mummy's dal baati was the best last Sunday, I'm telling everyone here in Pune about it.
Mausi, Gupta uncle's granddaughter is getting married in Udaipur, they've invited the whole lane, you're going na?

context: elder: The vegetable vendor raised prices again.
text: Tomatoes are expensive everywhere, Mummy, here also eighty a kilo, uh, use the dried ones you made for now.
Mummy, I made your mirchi vada today, a little too spicy, but Vikram ate four, so I think it's a success.
Papa, did Verma uncle's dog stop barking at night? You were saying you couldn't sleep last week.
Dadi, I found the same silver payal you lost, at Johari Bazaar, I'm getting it for your birthday, surprise.
Mummy, so, so the ghewar for Teej, should I buy from LMB or will you make at home this year?

context: elder: Mrs Joshi came for tea today.
text: Nice, Mummy, she's so cheerful, ask her about her yoga class, maybe both of you can go together in the mornings.
Papa, the new mall on Tonk Road has a lift and benches everywhere, I'll take both of you on Sunday, slowly.
Bhabhi, your methi ki launji recipe, I lost the paper, uh, can you send a voice note again?
Mausi, the colony is planning a Holi milan in the park, the committee wants you to sing like last year.
Mummy, I've put your monthly ration order in the app, atta, dal, ghee, it'll come tomorrow by noon.

context: elder: The pickle came out well this time.
text: I knew it, the lemon one? Save a jar for me, Mummy, I'll take it back to Hyderabad.
Papa, umm, the watchman said Mehta ji's son is visiting from America, you should invite them for dinner.
Dadi, which colour razai cover do you want, the blue block print or the pink Sanganeri one?
Mummy, the bajra roti breaks when I roll it, should I just, just pat it with my hands like you do?
Papa, Kapoor aunty asked if you'll take the morning walk group to Central Park again, they miss your jokes.

context: elder: How do I know this is real?
text: Ma'am, you can see the airway bill I sent on WhatsApp, it has the customs hologram and your full address, everything is genuine.
Mummy, the tailor in Raja Park said your blouses will be ready by Friday, I'll pick them on my way home.
